teaser.en: The tough, flat-stemmed grass in every footpath and compound, and the wild cousin of finger millet.
teaser.sw: Nyasi ngumu yenye mashina bapa iliyo katika kila njia na kila uwanja, na binamu wa porini wa wimbi.

summary.en: *Chimbikaya* is goosegrass, a tough, tufted weed of paths, compounds and fields. It is a wild relative of finger millet.
summary.sw: *Chimbikaya* ni nyasi inayoitwa kwa Kiingereza *goosegrass*, gugu gumu linaloota kwa mafungu kwenye njia, viwanja na mashamba. Ni jamaa wa porini wa wimbi.

about.en: Goosegrass is a low, tufted annual grass with flattened, pale-whitish stems at the base, so tough they are hard to pull up. Its flower head is a set of two to seven narrow spikes spreading like the fingers of a hand from the top of the stem, much like a small, loose finger-millet head. The seeds are tiny and the root system is dense and fibrous, so the plant survives being trampled.
about.sw: Nyasi hii ni nyasi fupi ya msimu mmoja inayoota kwa mafungu, yenye mashina bapa ya rangi hafifu nyeupe-nyeupe kwenye kitako, magumu kiasi kwamba ni vigumu kuyang'oa. Kichwa chake cha maua ni seti ya vishada virefu vyembamba viwili hadi saba vinavyotawanyika kama vidole vya mkono kutoka juu ya shina, kama kichwa kidogo cha wimbi kilicholegea. Mbegu ni ndogo sana na mfumo wa mizizi ni mnene na wa nyuzi nyuzi, kwa hiyo mmea huu hustahimili kukanyagwa.

where.en: It grows almost everywhere in the tropics, on trodden ground: paths, compounds, roadsides, and in farms as a weed.
where.sw: Huota karibu kila mahali katika maeneo ya tropiki, kwenye ardhi inayokanyagwa: njia, viwanja, kando ya barabara, na mashambani kama gugu.

names.en: Pakia records the Digo name *chimbikaya* and lists it among the names that cannot be analysed. The English names are goosegrass or Indian goosegrass. Cultivated finger millet (*Eleusine coracana*) belongs to the same genus.
names.sw: Pakia ameandika jina la Kidigo *chimbikaya* na analiorodhesha miongoni mwa majina yasiyoweza kuchambuliwa. Kwa Kiingereza inaitwa *goosegrass* au *Indian goosegrass*. Wimbi linalolimwa (*Eleusine coracana*) ni wa jenasi ile ile.

reason.en: Digitaria, another grass of farms and paths
reason.sw: Digitaria, nyasi nyingine ya mashambani na njiani
Nyasi inayowasha (itch grass), gugu jingine la shambani

reason.en: Stenotaphrum, a grass of trampled ground
